backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing event submissions, updating golfer scores, computing Callaway results, and exposing chart and latest results via queries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence metadata listing chart‑update and UI‑placeholder features with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of many frontend files describing routing, scoring flow, Callaway logic, chart persistence, and UI components.
frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md: Developer guide explaining how Callaway chart defaults are structured and how to update them in chart persistence code.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Notes marking restoration of a draft session without functional changes, summarizing current app capabilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS layer defining theme variables for light and dark modes with OKLCH color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file setting page metadata and mounting the React application root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top‑level React app configuring routing, scoring flow state machine, and invoking Callaway calculations for results.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component showing attribution link and dynamic copyright year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component showing title, navigation buttons, and admin/settings controls based on app state.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Displays the admin panel or an access-disabled warning and provides navigation plus chart editor access.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: Provides an interface to edit, validate, save, and reset 9- and 18-hole Callaway grid charts.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form for configuring event details including title, course info, golfer count, hole count, and par.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Shows detailed scoring breakdown for a golfer including gross, deductions, adjustment, and net score.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Renders the active Callaway scoring chart with grid values, adjustments, and explanation of how deductions work.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Generates a print-friendly HTML page in a new window and triggers PDF download for final standings.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Displays ranked leaderboard results with net, gross, deduction, and adjustment values and icons for top ranks.
Renders the leaderboard view with sorted results, a standings table, breakdown panels, and a PDF export button.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: Displays editable golfer info and hole scores, updating parent state and calculating gross totals.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer data, ensuring name, hole count, and score ranges are correct.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: Shows settings UI allowing admin access toggling and back navigation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and refreshes a backend actor based on Internet Identity and invalidates dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAccessEnabled: Tracks admin access state with localStorage and custom event listeners for sync across tabs.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, login/logout handling, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hook to fetch the latest result using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind layers, fonts, and OKLCH CSS variables for light/dark themes with golf‑styled color palette.
Defines Callaway chart entry types, legacy 9/18‑hole charts, and a helper to find the matching chart row for a gross score.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Manages localStorage persistence for Callaway grid charts, including edited charts, user defaults, migration detection, and default‑chart loaders.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/gridPlaceholde: Provides helper functions for detecting placeholder grid cells and converting values for display and parsing.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Handles admin‑access enable/disable state via localStorage and emits change events.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for event setup, golfer input data, and Callaway result records.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom fonts, OKLCH color variables, extensions, and plugins.
project_state.json: Captures project metadata, issues, and feature requirements related to Callaway grid defaults and UI placeholder behavior.
